quarterly_data.signal: Pasqal (first-half 2026 results in the prospectus): revenue of EUR 4.9 million in the six months to June 30, 2026, up 14% year over year, including 34% growth in QPU-related services revenue.

quarterly_data.signal: Customer CINECA: Pasqal inaugurated Italy's first neutral-atom quantum computer, a 140-qubit system deployed at CINECA, Italy's largest public supercomputing center, to be integrated with the Leonardo supercomputer for hybrid quantum-HPC workloads under the EuroHPC initiative.
Customer Credit Agricole CIB: named among Pasqal's customers; Pasqal also cites partnerships with NVIDIA and IBM (it is part of the IBM Quantum Network).
